_doc: Machine-readable product-studio org (S0.1, SP-20260530-001). β referee, α orchestrator; cross-domain gauntlets. `routing` maps each S0.2 artifact `contract.owner_domain` to the org domain + owning role. Enforced by /scan:domain-routing (validates against schemas/contracts/*.schema.json). v0.1 REVISABLE.
_role_registry_note: ADR-0007 keystone: per-role identity·model-map·dispatch-authority·enforcer·disposition live in role-registry.json. ED-024 (ADR-0010): the REPORTING-LINE STRUCTURE collapsed into the registry — the registry's `home`/`sub_home` + `dispatchable_by` are now the SINGLE structural source, verified against the on-disk spec tree by scan:role-parity (the independent, non-vacuous witness). The LIVE structural consumers (role-parity, org-roles.domainRoles/buildChainDoerRoles) now derive from the registry, NOT from `domains{}` below. `domains{}` is RETAINED as a non-authoritative legacy view ONLY because `routing`/`gauntlets` still reference its (stale, pre-rename) role names; its per-role roster (leads/specialists/builders + `agent`) is SUPERSEDED dead weight — E8 (stale-ref cleanup) physically removes it together with the routing-role rename. Do NOT re-add a structural consumer that reads `domains{}` rosters.

referee.scope: Cross-domain conflict, risk, final ship gate. Enters intra-domain ONLY for ship-gate or cross-domain conflicts — NOT every intra-domain disagreement (not an intra-domain appeal court). β EVT-org-gpt-rereview-beta-001.

_domains_superseded: ED-024 (ADR-0010): SUPERSEDED as the reporting-line structural source — role-registry.json (home/sub_home/dispatchable_by) is now the single structural source, witnessed against the on-disk spec tree by scan:role-parity. The per-role rosters below (leads/specialists/builders + their `role`/`agent`) carry STALE pre-rename names (director-of-marketing→director-of-growth, product-designer→design-lead, research-insight-lead→research-lead, etc.) and omit most live roles; NO live structural consumer reads them any more. Retained ONLY so `routing`/`gauntlets` (which still name these stale roles) keep resolving until E8 removes this block + renames the routing roles together. Treat as read-only legacy; do not extend.

leads.owns: requirement authoring (build_spec/PRD via /sprint:design, verified by req-reviewer); per-product backlog ranking + within-sprint sequencing
product-driven QA; QA/fix-priority under product-priority-over-severity; directs the QA failure-mode scanner
leads.note: ADR-0007: renamed director-of-qa → quality-lead (spec product/quality-lead.md). Reports to Director of Product Mgmt.

leads._adr0007: renamed research-insight-lead → research-lead; moved to Growth (spec growth/research-lead.md)
leads.owns: deep audience layer + audience-mining pipeline; audience_dossier

director._adr0007: renamed director-of-marketing → director-of-growth (spec growth/director-of-growth.md); dept Marketing → Growth

leads.owns: Agora/E5 voice; owns the 'Chief' coherence review

engineering.note: +Foundation/Integration builder roles only if the pilot shows shared-file pain (S1.3 Gamma integration phase owns shared files first).

code-qc.note: ADR-0007 cutover roster (was reviewer·compliance·qa·redteam·fixer). The generic `reviewer` SPLIT into per-pod frontend-reviewer + backend-reviewer (code-quality only); qa+compliance+req-reviewer ABSORBED into ONE qa-reviewer (traceability+integrity+functional scopes); redteam → ONE security-reviewer (the 2nd-GPT pass is INTERNAL to that role, not a separate member). fixer = remediation (runs after review, not a parallel reviewer). org-roles.reviewGauntletRoles('engineering') filters remediation; gauntletReviewRoles()/expectedGauntletRoles(pods) are the DERIVED rosters gamma.md/delta.md/the delta-* launchers consume — NO hardcoded --roles literal. Pod reviewers are gated to the pods that actually built (expectedGauntletRoles) so a FE-only build doesn't expect a backend-reviewer record.

design-quality.note: The named design authority across app-design (Product) and web-design (Marketing) — a gauntlet, not a person. A component library alone is not an owner.

claims_boundary.note: Marketing owns the market promise; Product owns the product-verifiable claim; they must not blur. Security/compliance review stays independent of Product/Marketing pressure (its own gauntlet lane). Rooted as the shared `claims-boundary` base principle.

routing._doc: Each S0.2 artifact `contract.owner_domain` -> the org domain + owning role. /scan:domain-routing asserts every owner_domain present in schemas/contracts/ has an entry here, and every entry's domain is defined above (or 'cross-domain').

enforcer_emitted.note: decision_record — emitted by any domain's enforcer in oneshot, no human present
